candidateName: Procurement Bid, Evaluation, Qualification and Award Profiles

cases.input: A criterion outcome is recorded by an actor who has no evaluatorRoster entry, mandate reference or impartiality declaration assigned before determination began.
cases.expect: Rejected: assessors are assigned and impartiality is declared before any determination is recorded.

cases.input: Evaluator X declares an interest in bid B2 and records the determination of that interest personally.
cases.expect: Rejected: each declared interest is determined by a party other than the declarant.

cases.input: After recusal on bid B2, evaluator X records a pairwise comparison whose result depends on B2.
cases.expect: Rejected: a recused evaluator scores neither the affected bid nor any comparison depending on it.

cases.input: X is recused with an effective instant; X's earlier round-2 outcomes are marked 'excluded' and a remediation round restates participation figures.
cases.expect: Original outcomes, the determination and the recusal instant all remain resolvable; nothing is deleted.

cases.input: A finalized round-2 criterion outcome is overwritten with a bias-adjusted value.
cases.expect: Rejected: bias adjustment and exclusion create new marked results in a successor round; finalized outcomes are never edited.

cases.input: Round-1 bid versions are scored under criteria v2 in round 2 without any new or re-affirmed submission.
cases.expect: Rejected: a bid version scored under criteria vN is never scored under vN+1; a new criteria version requires a solicitation round with new or re-affirmed submissions.

cases.input: An award names the selected bid but cites no criteria version, no relied-upon round and not all considered bids.
cases.expect: Rejected: the award cites the criteria version, the relied-upon evaluation round, every considered bid and the selected bid.

cases.input: An award copies per-criterion scores from the evaluation round into its own evaluation-results area while that BidEvaluation record exists.
cases.expect: Rejected: where a BidEvaluation exists the award references the round and aggregation relied upon and restates no criterion outcome.

cases.input: A single-source award exists with no BidEvaluation record and a declared noEvaluationGround.
cases.expect: Accepted: the absence of an evaluation is explicit and grounded; no outcomes are fabricated.

cases.input: Recording the award automatically instantiates a concluded agreement record.
cases.expect: Rejected: the award creates, signs and implies no agreement; conclusion, signature evidence and conditions precedent are separately evidenced.

cases.input: Recording the award automatically issues and marks accepted a purchase order.
cases.expect: Rejected: order issuance and acceptance are separate later acts, and issuance alone never proves contract formation.

cases.input: A supplier's qualification standing is entered as a scored criterion inside the bid evaluation, and the bid score then revises that standing.
cases.expect: Rejected: qualification and bid evaluation have different subjects and validity; neither writes into the other.

cases.input: Admissibility cites a qualification standing whose validity window ended before the bid receipt instant.
cases.expect: Rejected: admissibility pins a qualification standing valid as of receivedAt.

cases.input: The selected bid's validity window ended before awardedAt and no extension is recorded.
cases.expect: Rejected: award requires the selected bid to be valid at the award instant or a recorded extension.

cases.input: The profile candidate declares bases and prose constraints with no objects, no required fields, no fixtures file and no validation policy.
cases.expect: Rejected: a profile candidate declares testable objects and required fields and ships fixtures and a validation policy.

cases.input: The shared profile candidate covering bid, evaluation, qualification and award is stored inside the Procurement Request candidate directory whose boundary excludes those subjects.
cases.expect: Rejected: the profile candidate lives in its own shared location, not inside a candidate that disclaims its subjects.
